Title: Reader test
Prompt: Read this draft as the reader I name. List the sentences that assume knowledge the reader does not have. Do not rewrite yet.

Title: Cut a third
Use when: When the draft is too long.
Prompt: Cut this draft by about a third. Do not add examples, statistics, or quotations. Keep the original claims.
Check: The shorter draft has no new facts.

Title: Headline options
Prompt: Write eight headlines. Each must be true to the draft. Mark any headline that would overclaim.

Title: Specifics pass
Prompt: Replace vague nouns with the specific ones already in the draft. If a specific is missing, insert [missing specific] rather than inventing one.

Title: Opening
Use when: When the first paragraph is a warm-up.
Prompt: Propose two openings that start at the first concrete point in the draft. Do not add a story.
Check: The opening is already in the draft.

Title: Last check
Prompt: List factual claims in the draft that would need a source. Do not supply sources from memory.
